title: A Two-Mirror Faceted Projection System for EUV Lithography
abstract: arXiv:2609.11299v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose an all-reflective two-mirror projection system for extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography operating at exposure wavelengths of $13.5$~nm (Mo/Si) and $11.2$~nm (Ru/Be), delivering a fourfold ($4\times$) demagnification of the periodic mask pattern at a numerical aperture approaching unity ($\mathrm{NA}_{\max} \approx 0.993$). In contrast to conventional EUV projection objectives that incorporate 6--10 aspheric mirrors with an overall optical throughput of less than $15\%$, the proposed design redirects each accepted discrete spatial diffraction order scattered by the mask onto the wafer via a dedicated pair of planar mirror facets. The number of reflections is strictly fixed at two for all accepted orders, retaining $50$--$60\%$ of the power leaving the mask in each accepted order. translated_title: 一种用于极紫外光刻的双镜面分面投影系统
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种全反射式双镜面极紫外（EUV）光刻投影系统，工作波长为13.5 nm（Mo/Si）和11.2 nm（Ru/Be），在接近1的数值孔径（NA_max ≈ 0.993）下实现周期性掩模图形的四倍（4×）缩小。与传统采用6–10片非球面镜、整体光学透过率低于15%的EUV投影物镜不同，所提出的设计通过一对专用的平面镜面分片，将掩模散射出的每个被接收的离散空间衍射级重新导向晶圆。所有被接收的衍射级的反射次数严格固定为两次，从而在每个被接收的衍射级中保留离开掩模能量的50–60%。我们推导出一种空间几何结构，可在所有衍射级之间实现严格的光程相等，从而消除与衍射级相关的（相位差等）影响。
tldr: 提出一种仅需两次反射的双镜面分面式EUV光刻投影系统，通过严格光程均衡设计将每个衍射级的能量保留率提升至50–60%，远高于传统6–10镜系统不足15%的透过率。
en_tdlr: A two-mirror faceted EUV lithography projection system that uses exactly two reflections per diffraction order with rigorous optical path length equalization, retaining 50–60% of the mask output power compared to under 15% throughput in conventional 6–10 mirror designs.
